description: Instruction-driven image editing with Qwen-Image-Edit-2511. Preserves character identity and line style from up to 3 reference images while changing pose, wardrobe, expression, or props. Built for consistent character work. for big pose/wardrobe/scene edits flux3-klein-edit is better and ~20x faster. Prefer it for small precise additions such as hats and props.

prompt.description: Edit instruction, e.g. 'Change his pose so he is standing on his hind legs pointing forward with one paw. Keep everything else identical.'

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt. Usually leave empty for edit models.

image1.description: Primary reference image (filename after upload). This is the image being edited.

image2.description: Second reference for identity lock (e.g. a different angle of the same character). Repeat image1 if unused.

image3.description: Third reference for identity lock. Repeat image1 if unused.

megapixels.description: Working resolution. 1.0 = ~1024x1024. Raise for more detail, lower for speed.

steps.description: Sampling steps. 20 is the sweet spot for edit.

cfg.description: Guidance. 2.5 default. Raise toward 4 to force the instruction harder, lower toward 1.5 for gentler edits.

denoise.description: Keep at 1.0 for normal edits. Lower to 0.6-0.85 for very subtle changes that hug the source pixels.

angles_lora_strength.description: Multiple-Angles LoRA strength. 0 = off. Set 0.6-1.0 when asking for camera/body rotation ('turn him to a 3/4 view', 'show him from behind').
